description: For ebook products only. Export one or two selected interior pages as separate JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images and select them here. These samples are public. Never upload the full ebook or a purchased download URL here. Blank fields hide the preview button. Longlife Storefront Product Content 1.1.0 or newer exposes these samples through the Store API.
